text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During training with Calstone Light O, I 
saw Durandal looking troubled...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
She's late... I wonder if something 
happened to her?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Durandal, are you meeting someone? Looks 
like you've been waiting quite a while.

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Senpai, I'm so sorrry I'm late! Someone 
fell on the stairs, so I took her to the 
nurse's office... and, well. I kept you 
waiting... didn't I?!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... I just got here myself, so 
please don't worry about it.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Hm? Was that so? I've been around since—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
*Ahem!* Let's get right into the warm-up. 
First, the outer track! Now, shall we?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
—Light O-san! Are you familiar with the 
saying, "A lie is sometimes expedient"?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I know.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Then surely you understand, right? 
There's no need to tell the truth to an 
underclassman who was delayed by 
unavoidable circumstances and apologized 
sincerely."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Show kindness to the young. Absolute 
honesty isn't always the right answer, you 
know.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I don't get it. Why can't she just be 
honest?

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Senpai, thank you so much for your 
guidance today! Um... would it be okay if 
I come to you for help again?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Of course. I'd be happy to spar with you 
anytime.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"My holy sword reflects your unclouded 
visage. Young steed, continue to devote 
yourself diligently."

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yes! Well then, thanks for your hard work!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Heh... "Can I rely on you again?", huh...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Fufufufu!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wasn't I quite noble today? Now that 
is a true knight! Fufufu...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Wait...! How long have you two been 
standing there!?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Since a little while ago.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Which means...! You saw it, didn't you!? 
My... disgraceful state...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
(She feels super ashamed. I'm starting to 
feel a little sorry for her. I guess 
that's what they mean by 'white lies are a 
necessary evil.')

text_block_list.name: Honest Right O
text_block_list.text:
It's a fact that I saw her getting carried 
away. It's best to be honest and not hide 
it.

text_block_list.name: Justice Right O
text_block_list.text:
But knowing the truth would only hurt 
them. Pretending not to notice is an act 
of kindness.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
choice_data_list: (Right O is brooding, of all things?!)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Kh! What's with that silence!? Answer me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O continues to ponder 
seriously, but it also feels like both of 
them are overthinking it. Should I say 
something, or shouldn't I...?
choice_data_list: I should tell the truth soon!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O continues to ponder 
seriously, but it also feels like both of 
them are overthinking it. Should I say 
something, or shouldn't I...?
choice_data_list: I should tell the truth soon!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. It's better to tell the 
truth as soon as possible.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Durandal, we saw you looking all giddy and 
excited.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Still, I think you have every right to be 
excited. What you did was just that 
wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
To her, you were a noble knight. Isn't 
that enough?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
D-Does that mean... to others, I truly 
looked like a noble knight?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so! Well, I have nothing to be 
ashamed of regarding my actions. Please 
excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, honesty really is the best policy 
after all. It's nothing to be ashamed of.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After saying that, Calstone Light O 
returned to her usual self. It made me 
realize once again that honesty is truly 
her virtue.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Ngh! Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"We definitely didn't see Durandal humming 
happily while acting all knight-like!"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: You were watching after all, weren't you?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Calstone Light O's nature simply 
won't allow her to tell a lie...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Kh...! But... it is entirely due to my own 
shortcomings. None of you are to blame.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. You've helped me 
realize something important.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"As a knight, I must discipline myself 
even further."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Durandal...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed. You do love to be praised, after 
all."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O tried to tell a gentle 
lie out of a sense of justice. However, 
she remained straightforward to the very 
end!
